name: Sparse Structures
statusMeaning: Calls something that is on Kiln's roadmap. Parts of it may already run.
author: m
description: A simple and configurable mod that makes all (even datapacks and modded) structures more spread out (or more common!), essentially making them rarer/easier to find. Useful in big modpacks with a lot of structures mods to encourage exploration
needs: Mixin: 3 points inside the game's methods
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers.
